text:
ming: Heads up — after yesterday's AWQ deploy with mixed group sizes we're seeing coldstart instability. p99 spikes and a small but consistent accuracy dip on the long-tail eval set. logs attached below.
amira: ugh. is this during scale-up or steady-state?
sasha: coldstart specifically? that would hint at KV cache priming / shard warmup differences.
jon: can you paste the config that went to canary? curious about group-grid and act-quant settings.
ming: sure, here's the canary config we used:
```
model: vicuna-13b-awq
quant: awq
group_grid: [4,8,16]
act_quant: true
hetero_grouping: true
batcher: hetero_batcher
kv_prefill: true
rollout: canary 20%
```
leo: mixing groups in the same serving group is new — did we validate compatibility across kernels? some kernels pick different fused paths.
ming: we ran perf bench locally; latency looked fine. but production shows token-level noise: on story-qa @eval EM -1.8% (baseline 0), ppl +3.2, stop-token rate +0.9%.
qa-bot: quick summary from eval harness: dataset=story-qa, n=1200, baseline_em=72.4, current_em=70.6, pval<0.01.
amira: that EM drop is small but consistent. does it correlate with specific prompts (long contexts / streaming)?
sasha: preliminary filtering shows most regressions on long-prefix prompts (>1024). suspect KV cache handling when group boundaries differ — prefix cache alignment might be off.
jon: any stack traces or warnings in runtime logs? maybe an index misalignment when mixing group sizes.
ming: logs snippet (truncated):
```
[2026-03-19T18:02:33Z] worker-7 WARN kv_cache: mismatched-prefix-length expected=512 got=496
[2026-03-19T18:02:33Z] worker-7 INFO awq: group=4->kernel=awq_fused_v1
[2026-03-19T18:02:33Z] worker-12 INFO awq: group=16->kernel=awq_fused_v3
[2026-03-19T18:02:34Z] worker-7 ERROR decode: token_loss_spike=1.9
```
leo: that mismatched-prefix-length is suspicious — could be a preallocation bug where different group paths assume different kv block sizes.
amira: can we reproduce by forcing hetero_grouping=false and using a single group size across the canary? if accuracy holds, that isolates the issue.
jon: agree. also try disabling act_quant as a fast check.
ming: quick repro plan: 1) small canary with group=8 only, act_quant=true 2) canary with group_grid but act_quant=false 3) run long-prefix eval and collect token-deltas.
qa-bot: queued test jobs: job/4567 (group=8), job/4568 (grid+act=false). ETA ~45m.
deploy-bot: rolled canary back to 10% and pinned workers to single-group=8 per host. monitoring p95/p99.
sasha: if it's KV priming, warmup policy could help: prefill KV from a synthetic prefix to unify block alignment.
ming: added a warmup hook to the canary invocation (kv_prefill_samples=20). starting now.
leo: also log a small debug metric: kv_block_count_per_shard and first_token_index to correlate.
jon: if repro fails, next hypothesis is quant activation path divergence — AWQ kernels might handle SIMD rounding differently across group sizes causing tiny probability shifts that cascade.
amira: and if that's true, we need a numerical regression test in the CI for deterministic seeds and long-prefix prompts.
ming: quick interim findings (from job/4567 at 30m): group=8-only canary shows EM delta -0.2% (within noise), p99 latency +6ms, no kv warnings.
ming: job/4568 (grid+act=false) still shows EM -1.6% and same kv warnings.
jon: that strongly points to hetero_grouping path, not act_quant.
sasha: next steps: 1) revert hetero_grouping on the rollout, 2) add unit test that simulates mixed group decode and verifies kv index stability, 3) PR to add normalization of kv-block sizes across kernels.
amira: +1. also surface this in the release notes: "AWQ hetero-grouping experimental — may cause coldstart instability" so customers know.
qa-bot: marking incident ticket INC-2026-77 and linking eval artifacts.
ming: I'll open the unit test PR and follow up. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
leo: for tracking, adding an experiment note: "hetero-grid-coldstart-2026-03-19" and log seed/config used.
ming: confirmed: canary rollback to single-group 8; monitoring shows metrics back to baseline after warmup. closing interim alert. will post postmortem when root cause clear.
